rationale: Predeclared DUD-E extension spanning an enzyme, kinase and nuclear receptor. No local ranking outcomes used to select these targets. Prior ESR1 success and FA10/TRYB1 failures remain in the overall evidence; this extension does not replace them.
selection: SHA256 ordering of canonical isomeric SMILES among first 2000 unique eligible source molecules; 12-55 heavy atoms, one component, supported elements, finite supplied 3D coordinates. Retain preparation failures; no replacement.
preparation: Same supplied-DUD-E-conformer/Meeko preparation recipe as previous panel; frozen 30 A crystal-centered box. Record all input hashes. No target-specific retuning after stock outcomes.

comparison.matching: ceil(normal E8 evaluation count / 256000) independent units per ligand; disclose eval and time ratios
comparison.bootstrap: paired stratified compound resampling across seeds; 5000 samples; report each seed and target, not only pooled results

scope: Conditional preservation on stock-qualified targets; small active/decoy panel, not full-library screening or universal target quality. Retain failed gates and missing jobs. No optional stopping within a preselected panel.
identifier_correction: Before any new docking: DUD-E names dihydrofolate reductase DYR, not DHFR. Corrected URL identifier after an HTTP 404; biological target unchanged.
